entries.title: Psalms 95:1
segments:
PSALM XCV. 
 
  The author of this psalm was David, as is affirmed,
.   It has a special reference to the days of the Messiah; as it is   understood by the apostle,
.   Herein we are called upon, to praise God, as a great and gracious God,   ver. 1-7.   To hear God's voice, and not harden our hearts, lest we fall as the   Israelites did, ver. 8-11.

entries.title: Psalms 95:3
segments: V. 3. God's-Above all that are called God's angels, earthly potentates, and especially the false gods of the Heathen.

entries.title: Psalms 95:4
segments: V. 4. Hand-Under his government.  Strength-The strongest or highest mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 95:7
segments: V.7. Pasture-Whom he feeds and keeps in his own pasture, or in the land which he hath appropriated to himself.  The sheep-Which are under his special care.  Today-Forthwith or presently.

entries.title: Psalms 95:8
segments: V. 8. Harden not-By obstinate unbelief.  Provocation-In that bold and wicked contest with God in the wilderness.  Temptation-In the day in which you tempted me.

entries.title: Psalms 95:9
segments: V. 9. Works-Both of mercy, and of justice.

entries.title: Psalms 95:10
segments: V. 10. Do err-Their hearts are insincere and bent to backsliding. Not known-After all my teaching and discoveries of myself to them; they did not know, nor consider, those great things which I had wrought for them.

entries.title: Psalms 95:11
segments: V. 11. My rest-Into the promised land, which is called the rest,
